standard-commuter.name: Standard Commuter Schedule
standard-commuter.description: 5:30 AM start, gym before work, 40-min commute each way, 9–6 job.

weekday.title: Wake up & hydrate
weekday.desc: 16 oz water immediately. No phone for 5 min.

weekday.title: Morning mobility (15 min)
weekday.desc: Hip circles, leg swings, ankle rotations, shoulder rolls.

weekday.title: Drive to gym — fasted
weekday.desc: Train fasted on shred protocol. No pre-workout snack.

weekday.title: WORKOUT (55–70 min)
weekday.desc: Follow weekly split. End with knee rehab every session.

weekday.title: Shower & get ready
weekday.desc: 30 min max. You already won the morning.

weekday.title: Breakfast + pack lunch
weekday.desc: Log in MFP before eating. Grab prepped container.

weekday.title: Commute to work (~40 min)
weekday.desc: Audiobook the entire drive. 80 min reading per day.

weekday.title: Work
weekday.desc: Lunch at 12:30 PM. 8 oz water every 2 hours.

weekday.title: Lunch (prepped container)
weekday.desc: Pre-portioned Sunday container. Log before eating.

weekday.title: Commute home
weekday.desc: Continue audiobook. Mentally transition from work.

weekday.title: Cook & eat dinner
weekday.desc: Lean protein + veggies + small carbs. Log before plating.

weekday.title: Evening walk (30 min)
weekday.desc: Zone 1 pace. Burns ~150 cal. Kills nighttime cravings.

weekday.title: Personal time
weekday.desc: No agenda. Watch something, relax, recharge.

weekday.title: Prep for tomorrow (15 min)
weekday.desc: Gym bag, clothes, lunch packed. Remove all friction.

weekday.title: Screens off — wind down
weekday.desc: Dim lights. No scrolling. This makes 5:30 AM possible.

weekday.title: Lights out
weekday.desc: Protect every hour. Poor sleep = stalled fat loss.

weekend_sat.title: Wake naturally — hydrate
weekend_sat.desc: No alarm. Let the body recover. Water first.

weekend_sat.title: WORKOUT — Saturday
weekend_sat.desc: Long cardio + bodyweight circuit. See workout tab.

weekend_sat.title: Breakfast — take your time
weekend_sat.desc: Cook something real. Same macro targets apply.

weekend_sat.title: Dinner — stay on plan
weekend_sat.desc: Weekends kill most diets. Consistency is the game.

weekend_sat.title: Extended reading (45–60 min)
weekend_sat.desc: More time than weekdays — use it.

weekend_sat.title: Lights out — keep consistent
weekend_sat.desc: Sleeping in past 8 AM Sunday makes Monday brutal.

weekend_sun.title: Wake naturally — hydrate
weekend_sun.desc: Rest day. No alarm needed. Water first.

weekend_sun.title: Extended mobility + stretch
weekend_sun.desc: 20 min. Slower pace. Honor the recovery.

weekend_sun.title: Breakfast — relaxed
weekend_sun.desc: Same macro targets. Cook something you enjoy.

weekend_sun.title: SUNDAY MEAL PREP (2 hrs)
weekend_sun.desc: Batch cook proteins. Rice. 5 lunch containers. Batch sauce.

weekend_sun.title: Dinner — light and clean
weekend_sun.desc: Lighter than usual. Prep for a strong Monday.

weekend_sun.title: Weekly check-in (15 min)
weekend_sun.desc: Review the week. Plan the next one. Be honest.

weekend_sun.title: Reading (30 min)
weekend_sun.desc: Wind-down reading. No screens after this.

weekend_sun.title: Early lights out
weekend_sun.desc: Better Monday starts with better Sunday night.

steps.action: Set up direct deposit from your job → main checking account
steps.why: Eliminates bank service fees. One call, 10 minutes.
Every dollar saved on recurring fees is guaranteed ROI.

steps.action: Pay more than minimum on highest-interest debt
steps.why: High-interest debt is a guaranteed negative return. Eliminating it is the safest investment available.

steps.action: Open a high-yield savings account (HYSA) — Ally or Marcus
steps.why: Emergency fund needs to be separate, earning 4%+, out of sight.

steps.action: Add a side income stream (gig work, weekend shifts)
steps.why: Extra income compresses the debt payoff timeline dramatically.
First buffer. Stops you using credit cards for emergencies.

steps.action: Open a Roth IRA — start at $50/month
steps.why: Tax-free growth. Time in market beats timing the market — start small now.
Zero interest payments. You own your money instead of owing it.
Full 3-month buffer. Real financial security floor.
Compounding only works over time — earlier is always better.

steps.action: Audit all subscriptions — cancel everything unused
steps.why: Recurring waste is the easiest money to recover.

steps.action: Open Ally Bank HYSA or Marcus
steps.why: Emergency fund needs 4%+ APY, separate from checking.
Pay yourself first — automate it so it's not a decision.
First real buffer. Changes how you handle unexpected expenses.
Covers most car repairs, medical costs, or income gaps.
You have a foundation now. Time to start building wealth.
3-month baseline achieved. Solid financial floor.

steps.action: Review and pay down any remaining high-interest debt
steps.why: With savings base secure, eliminate interest drain.
Real wealth-building phase begins.

steps.action: Explore index fund investing beyond Roth IRA
steps.why: Diversify beyond tax-advantaged limits.
